children: Canada apparel retailer's fiscal Q2 revenue fell 1.9% yr/yr
Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q2 declined 12.1% from last year
On July 30, the company renewed share buyback, may repurchase up to 3 mln shares over next 12 months
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current qtr or full yr
GROSS MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - Co said gross margin rose due to stronger regular-price selling, reduced markdowns and tighter inventory management

CHANNEL PERFORMANCE - Retail store comparable sales increased, with flagship locations delivering double-digit sales growth, while e-commerce revenue declined due to reduced clearance and promotional activity
HIGHER OPERATING EXPENSES - Increased freight, rent, store wages, advertising and early loyalty program development offset gross profit gains
REVENUE DECREASED - Net revenues decreased 1.9% to $211.8 mln primarily due to lower transaction volume and reduced clearance activity compared to the prior year
